From this, what can conclude? The centre operators on a first-come-first-served basis, but with variable service times, depending on specific customer needs. Customers were served in an arbitrary order, since they took varying amounts of time for service completion in the centre. Since some people came out within a few minutes of entering the centre, the system is likely to operate on a last-come-first-served basis.
